author: Jonell Thibault
text: The Royal Flush team was great to work with! From my first call with John to figure out what I needed, to the work that Shane and Justin did, I was impressed with their kindness, professionalism, and transparency. They really went the extra mile to make sure my home was taken care of and I highly recommend working with them.

author: Susan Baker
text: We asked for a quote to repair a main drain on a residential home. Their charge was $500 to pull a toilet and put a camera in the drain to see the damage.  This amount would get credited back if we contracted their services. It took 15 minutes for this service and they weren't here for more than a half hour and we were told it was a very affordable repair. That would have been fine if they gave us an honest quote. Their quote for a repair with no demolition was many thousands over other quotes to totally replace the drain including some demolition. Another companies charged much less or nothing for the same evaluation.  Save yourself the $500. THAT WAS NOT AN HONEST QUOTE. THEY WERE HOLDING A ROYAL FLUSH HAND!

author: Brian Jackson
text: Prompt response from owner (John). On time arrival by tech (Sean). He was a seasoned professional, did job of video camera observation through the piping all the way out to the septic tank. We discussed his assessment of the issue / resolution. I am happy with the company’s response and the quality of their work. I would hire them again, for sure.

author: Andy Schanno
text: Outstanding service and communication.   John and his crew were extremely professional and courteous.   Their pipe sleeve technology was fast and efficient, shoring up our septic line, while preventing us from having to dig up our whole basement and yard.  Would definitely recommend!

author: Edward Couitt
text: We had a clogged main line we called them and within a half an hour they were here. Shane was the service guy and was very courteous and professional. He was finished in a half hour. Highly recommended to say the least.
